versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the base-station-antenna-monitor skill.
- Monitors base station antenna patents from 17 core companies, including Huawei, Commscope, Ericsson.
- Automatically classifies patents into three technical branches: vibrators, radome, and reflector.
- Extracts patent summaries and generates a professional HTML report with keyword cloud and patent table.
- Supports custom monitoring period, search limits, and output path via command-line parameters.
- Requires MCP service configuration for full patent data access; provides instructions for setup.
